title: Case: Brineleaf confirms replacement feed stock after warehouse damage report
context: Brineleaf Pantry's warehouse identified and packaged a replacement shipment for the damaged feed stock. The consignee has already confirmed receipt of the replacement in the business portal. The desk is waiting for billing correction notification from Brineleaf's refunds team, but no timeline has been set.
initial_request: Should the desk follow up on the replacement delivery?

events.body: DL-947 arrived with 8 sacks of Brineleaf premium poultry feed. 3 sacks soaked and spoiled in transit. We've logged damage in the portal and images attached. Need replacement ASAP—birds are on a tight schedule.

events.from: Dara Nisbet, Brineleaf Pantry Damage intake
events.body: Damage claim DL-947-DMG received. We've authorised replacement of 3 sacks. Warehouse dispatch is packing now. Will advise tracking once it ships.
Replacement arrived and verified. All 3 sacks in good condition. We've confirmed receipt in the portal. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

events.from: Dara Nisbet, Brineleaf Pantry Damage intake
events.body: DL-947: replacement delivered and logged in your system. Our warehouse has marked the original 3 damaged sacks as written off. We'll send the refund adjustment to your business portal once our refunds team processes it. ETA early next week.

must: Document that Brineleaf has confirmed replacement delivery and written off the damage
Acknowledge internally that a billing adjustment is pending and expected early next week without sending a message to any party
Recognize that FarmCo has already confirmed replacement receipt, eliminating any need to re-contact them
must_not: Send a follow-up message to Jasper Kern or FarmCo asking for confirmation—they have already confirmed
Contact Brineleaf's refunds team to chase the billing adjustment—Nisbet has set an ETA and chasing now would duplicate the damage intake team's own workflow
Escalate to a supervisor; this is routine damage-and-replace closure, not a safety or coordination breakdown
Send a message to the desk asking for next steps—the next step (refund processing) is owned by Brineleaf and is on their schedule

rationale: The replacement delivery is complete and acknowledged by the consignee. Brineleaf has already committed to a billing adjustment with a stated timeline and does not need the desk to chase it. Sending another message would duplicate work already assigned to Brineleaf's refunds team and would be noise rather than coordination. The desk should log the closure and wait for the billing notification.
